elements.text: Cross-Border Supply Chain Risk Assessment & Cost Optimization

This quarter's sourcing review identified critical supply chain risks across our cross-border warehouses. Two HIGH-risk stockout situations require immediate action, two MEDIUM-risk items need monitoring, and one cost optimization win has been secured on packaging.

Risk Items Identified:

1. HIGH — Single-source dependency on Xiamen supplier; CAMP-TENT-2P stockout at US-West warehouse with no alternative vendor qualified

2. HIGH — 4.2% breakage rate on ceramic imports causing DECOR-VASE-CER stockout at EU-DE warehouse; packaging inadequate for transatlantic shipping

3. MEDIUM — PET-BED-LG critically low at US-East (12 units vs 80 safety stock); demand spike from summer season approaching

4. MEDIUM — LED-PANEL-40W at APAC-SG approaching reorder point; lead time from ShenZhen supplier has increased to 6 weeks

Packaging Cost Reduction:

SKU PKG-KRAFT-M (Kraft Mailer Medium): Renegotiated with EcoPack Ltd for thinner kraft board. Savings of $0.04/box (from $0.38 to $0.34 per unit). At current US-West volume of 8,500 units, this represents $340 immediate savings. Apply new pricing to US-West warehouse stock immediately; EU-DE pricing under separate negotiation.

1. Mark HIGH-risk items in inventory tracker for immediate action
2. Expedite pending POs for stockout SKUs
3. Apply negotiated packaging cost to US-West warehouse
4. Begin dual-source qualification for CAMP-TENT-2P
5. Review ceramic packaging standards for EU-DE shipments
